title: Signoff: Agent Loop RPC plan + test harness
description:
Verify docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md and docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md
against actual implementation.

Code packages to compare against:
- internal/agent/api/ (AgentService interface, types, codec)
- internal/agent/service.go (AgentLoopService)
- internal/agent/agenttest/ (mock driver, test stack)
- internal/rpc/server/agent_server.go (AgentRPCServer)
- internal/rpc/client/agent_client.go (AgentServiceClient)
- internal/rpc/codec/agent_map.go (wire codec)
- internal/rpc/transport/server.go (refactored transport.Server)
- internal/rpc/errors.go (error mapping)
- internal/sandbox/control/ (SandboxControl interface)
- internal/sandbox/control/native/ (NativeSandboxControl)
- internal/sandbox/control/cloud/ (CloudSandboxControl stub)
- cmd/flexagent/ (unified binary)
- tests/integration/agent_rpc/ (E2E tests)
- tests/integration/scenarios/agent_rpc_*.go (fork + resume tests)

Instructions:
1. Read the plan doc thoroughly — build checklist of every type, interface, method, 
   algorithm, config option, error path, and cross-component contract
2. Compare each checklist item against the actual code
3. Classify deviations: Cosmetic, Structural, Contractual, or Missing
4. For test harness doc: verify each test category has corresponding test files/functions,
   counts match, CI integration works
5. Run: go test ./internal/agent/... ./internal/rpc/... ./internal/sandbox/control/... 
   ./cmd/flexagent/... ./tests/integration/agent_rpc/... ./tests/integration/scenarios/... -count=1
6. Run with race detector on concurrent code:
   go test -race ./internal/agent/... ./internal/rpc/... -count=1
7. Determine status per deviation severity rules
8. Append Completion Signoff section to each doc
9. Commit and push, report back via h2 send

comments.author: Danny Cosson
